layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Cinematic negative space. High contrast.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: GSAP-style smooth reveals, parallax depth, and luxury hover states.
motion_and_interactions.loader: Pure black screen #050505, typographic logo appears in #D4AF37, slowly glows, scales down to navbar position.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Fade up with gentle translation (y: 40) and long duration (0.8s), staggered for lists.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Background elements and hero images move at 0.5x scroll speed.

hover_states.cards: Slight lift (-translate-y-2), border color intensifies to #FFD700/40, inner image scale (1.05).
hover_states.buttons_primary: Background flows/shines with gold (#D4AF37 to #FFD700), text remains #050505.

loader.description: Full screen #050505 overlay. 'Bansi Vihar' typography in gold (#D4AF37) center screen. Add glow filter. Fades out after 2-3 seconds.

header.description: Sticky top nav. Uses glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0B0B]/60 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/10). Appears after loader finishes. 'Bansi Vihar' logotype.

hero.layout: Grid 12-col. Left (span 7): Heading, Subheading, CTAs. Right (span 5): Huge floating food visual.
hero.visuals: Image MUST use CSS `drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2))` to create the soft golden glow. Animate slightly up and down to simulate floating.
hero.cta: Primary CTA uses #D4AF37 bg with #050505 text. Secondary CTA uses border #D4AF37 text #FFFFFF.

signature_collection.layout: Alternating left-right. Row 1: Image Left, Text Right. Row 2: Text Left, Image Right. Massive images.
signature_collection.visuals: Images use smooth border radius (e.g., rounded-3xl) or borderless pure black blending. Subtle golden ambient light behind elements.

restaurant_story.layout: Centered massive typography or split layout. 'A Tradition Loved By Generations'. Uses the interior shot as a parallax background with a #050505/80 overlay.

gallery.layout: Masonry grid (columns: 1 md:2 lg:3). Images have hover zoom (scale 1.05 within hidden overflow container).

reviews.layout: Bento style or clean grid. Use Framer Motion or react-countup for animated '9680+' and '4.1' numbers.

contact_and_footer.layout: Map iframe embedded with dark mode styling. Buttons for WhatsApp and Call.
contact_and_footer.visuals: Footer purely #050505, minimalist links, gold accent lines.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion for all scroll reveals, loader, and floating animations.
Install react-countup for the reviews section.
Use Tailwind config to add custom colors (primary: #050505, secondary: #0B0B0B, gold: #D4AF37, accent: #FFD700) and fonts (heading: 'Cormorant Garamond', body: 'Outfit').
DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards with white backgrounds. All containers must be dark #0B0B0B or fully transparent with glassmorphism borders.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Strictly adhere to the dark and gold luxury aesthetic. Avoid pure white backgrounds anywhere.
Use the specific media URLs provided in this JSON. DO NOT use placeholder services.
